shard: Belgium, the Netherlands and Turkey: every pending row of scripts/data/rosterConfirmation2026.json whose club plays in the Belgian Pro League, the Eredivisie or the Süper Lig as Club Manager models them for 2026-27 (60 rows at origin/main 5f2622fd: Belgium 20, Netherlands 18, Turkey 22)
method: Each row was read on the web on 2026-10-03, never a wiki. The session's web search budget was already spent when this shard started, so every page was reached directly: ESPN's public roster JSON for each club's 2026-27 squad (site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/soccer/<league>/teams/<id>/roster, the data behind the squad page cited in each row, read with a small node script so the name, shirt number and birth date come from the data rather than a summary), ESPN's athlete records for where a man went, and the clubs' and leagues' own squad pages, fetched raw and searched for the name. A row leaves pending only when an official page (family A: the club's own squad or player page, or the league's) and an independent publisher on another host (family B: ESPN) agree where the man is. Birth dates are in the note so a namesake cannot be mistaken for him. A season-long loanee is placed at the club he plays for, the ledger's loanPolicy. The to field is the Club Manager club name the bake knows; realClub is the club as the sources write it. This file is folded into rosterConfirmation2026.json by the lead; nothing reads it directly.
